1: Jab sooraj ka wujood lapet diya jayega aur us ki roshni jaati rahegi.
2: Jab sitare ek ke baad ek gir jayenge aur un ki roshni chheen li jayegi.
3: Jab pahaar apni jaghon se hata diye jayenge.
4: Jab hamila oontniyan, jo un ka sab se qeemti maal thin, apne maalikon ki taraf se chhor di jayengi aur be-tawajjoh reh jayengi.
5: Jab jangli jaanwar insaano ke saath ek hi maidan mein jama kiye jayenge.
6: Jab samandar bharka diye jayenge yahan tak ke aag ban jayenge.
7: Jab rooheinan apni jaisi roohon ke saath mila di jayengi: gunahgar gunahgar ke saath, aur neik neik ke saath.
8: Jab zinda gaari gayi larki se Allah poochega:
9: “Tujhe kis jurm mein us shaks ne qatl kiya jis ne tujhe qatl kiya?”
10: Jab bandon ke aamaal-naame khol kar phaila diye jayenge, taake har shaks apna aamaal-naama parh le.
11: Jab aasman utaar liya jayega, jis tarah bhed ki khaal utaari jaati hai.
13: Jab jannat un logon ke qareeb kar di jayegi jo taqwa ikhtiyar karte hain.
14: Jab yeh sab hoga, to har jaan jaan legi ke us ne us din ke liye kaise aamaal aage bheje thay.
15: Allah ne un sitaron ki qasam khai jo chhupe rehte hain yahan tak ke raat ko zahir hote hain,
16: jo apne madaron mein chalte hain aur subah nikalne par gayab ho jaate hain, us hiran ki tarah jo apni kamin-gaah, yani apne ghar mein daakhil ho jata hai.
17: Us ne raat ke pehle hisse ki qasam khai jab woh aata hai, aur aakhiri hisse ki jab woh palat jata hai.
18: Us ne subah ki qasam khai jab us ki roshni phootti hai.
19: Jo Quran Muhammad ﷺ par utara gaya, woh Allah ka kalaam hai, jo ek amanat-dar farishte, Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ke zariye pahunchaya gaya, jin ke sapurd Allah ne usey kiya.
20: Woh quwwat wale hain aur Arsh ke Rubb ke nazdeek bare martabe wale hain, jo paak hai.
21: Aasman walon mein un ki itaat ki jaati hai, aur jo wahi woh pahunchate hain us mein woh amanat-dar hain.
22: Muhammad ﷺ, jo tumhare darmiyan hain aur jin ki aql, amanat-dari aur sachchai tum jaante ho, woh deewane nahin jaisa tum bohtan lagate ho.
23: Tumhare saathi ne Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ko aasman ke roshan kinare par usi soorat mein dekha jis mein woh paida kiye gaye.
24: Tumhare saathi tum se bakheeli nahin karte ke jo pahunchane ka unhein hukm diya gaya woh tum tak na pahunchayein, aur na woh koi ajr lete hain jaisa kahin lete hain.
25: Yeh Quran kisi aise shaytan ka kalaam nahin jo Allah ki rehmat se door kar diya gaya.
26: To in tamam daleelon ke baad tum kis raaste par chal kar is baat ka inkaar karte ho ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai?
27: Quran to jinn aur insaano ke liye sirf ek yaad-dihani aur nasihat hai.
28: Un logon ke liye jo tum mein se haqq ke raaste par qayam rehna chahte hain.
29: Aur tum qayam rehne ka ya kisi aur baat ka irada bhi nahin kar sakte, siwaye us soorat mein ke Allah, tamam makhlooq ka Rubb, yeh chahe.
